notes:
The mouse pointer is now recorded. Menus, the inventory and the craftbot
were invisible to training before this: Windows hands the cursor to a screen
capture separately from the picture, so it was in no recorded frame at all.
It is drawn into the frames now, and only while a menu is open.

Teammate audio actually records. If the peer track turns out to be picking
up silence -- which happens when a virtual audio cable is installed but the
voice chat is not routed into it -- it switches itself over to your speakers
a minute in, instead of recording nothing for the whole session.

A recording no longer fails because one part of it does. A microphone, the
video archive or the teammate track that will not open now costs only itself
and says which one it was; the gameplay is kept either way.

Large recordings are split into 500 MB pieces for upload. If your connection
cannot carry a multi-gigabyte upload in one go, each piece is sent and
retried on its own. Upload everything in the folder, in any order.
